title: An eval judge is another model, and one judge reads both arms

statements.says: The judge that says whether a sheet holds a Statement is an Opus when the backfill ran on a Fable, and a Fable when it ran on an Opus.
The harness asks for the judge by alias and records the model id it was given beside every number.
A comparison judges both arms in one go.
A comparison keeps every sheet, so when the judge moves the old arm is judged again at the price of a judge call, never a two-hour run.
A model recognises its own text and prefers it, so a fresh instance of the writer is not a judge.
A pinned judge version is upkeep nobody does, and one day stops resolving.
A paired comparison needs not a fixed judge for ever but one judge for both of its arms, so the judge's drift can never read as a change in the skill.
Pinning the judge's model id in a setting was rejected, because the pin goes stale and a bump between two comparisons silently changes what the numbers mean.
Judging with the model that wrote the sheet, in a fresh Session, was rejected, because self-preference is the bias the rule exists to stop.
